title: Selected books
description: Returned by the Librarian to the coordinator for one expert assignment. It selects exact book editions or reports that too few familiar books qualified; it does not supply book contents or private familiarity evidence.

failure.description: Generic coordinator-only failure. It reveals no private familiarity evidence and is never forwarded to the expert.

books.description: Canonical books selected for both the expert's field and this specific architecture problem: two to four for an initial request, exactly one for a replacement request.

id.description: Temporary in the Librarian response. The coordinator replaces all ids with sequential b1 through bN before forwarding a rebuilt record to the expert.

edition.description: Exact published edition selected for this assignment; vague values such as latest are invalid.

expertise_fit.description: High-level subject fit only. Do not expose a named or paraphrased book-specific idea from the private gate.

problem_fit.description: High-level problem-category fit only. Do not expose a named or paraphrased book-specific idea from the private gate.

selection_rationale.description: High-level reason this set covers the expert lens and problem better than one book alone, without exposing book-specific recalled material. For a replacement request, why the one book fits the expert lens and problem, at the same high level.
